items.headline: Atlas Lithium Announce ~71% Of Neves Project Capex Is Supported By Executed Contracts And Firm Agreements With Selected Execution Partners
items.snippet: A Tightening Lithium Market Underscores the Value of Near-term, Low-cost Supply. Albemarle Corporation, the leading U.S. lithium producer, reported that global lithium consumption grew 45% year-over-year through May 2026, while new supply additions lagged.

items.headline: [US Feature Stocks] Albemarle reaches tentative wage agreement with union day before Chilean strike
items.snippet: Albemarle (ALB), the world's largest lithium supplier, reached a tentative wage agreement with Chilean union leadership on the final day of negotiation talks ahead of a strike.

items.headline: Albemarle's Next CEO Inherits A $250 Million Swing Per Dollar
items.snippet: JPMorgan analyst Jeffrey Zekauskas recently cut Albemarle's 2026 adjusted EBITDA estimate by 14.4% to $2.88 billion, pointing to Chinese lithium prices averaging about $21,625 a ton so far in the third quarter, down from $24,810 in the second.

items.headline: Market Chatter: Lithium Miners' Profits Surge as Battery Storage Demand Drives Prices Higher
items.snippet: Lithium producers from China to Australia has seen profits soar as unrelenting demand from the energy storage sector pushes prices higher. US-headquartered Albemarle (ALB) noted that global lithium demand grew 45% through May this year, significantly outstripping supply.

items.headline: Albemarle to Benefit From Low-cost Assets, Brownfield Opportunity, RBC Says
items.snippet: Albemarle (ALB) will likely benefit from factors like its low-cost assets, brownfield opportunity, as well as continued focus on earnings improvement in Specialties. RBC has an outperform rating on Albemarle and decreased the company's price target to $157 from $166.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $225 from $245 at Truist
items.snippet: Truist analyst Peter Osterland lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $225 from $245 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares, citing resilient lithium demand and constrained supply dynamics.
